import numpy as np, torch, model
torch.manual_seed(0)
n=4096
xi=torch.randn(n,2); c=torch.rand(n)
xi2=torch.randn(n,2)
nets={v:model.load(v) if v!='v0' else model.load() for v in ['v0','v1','v2']}
outs={}
for v,net in nets.items():
    a=model.decode(net,xi,c)
    a=a[0] if isinstance(a,tuple) else a
    outs[v]=np.asarray(a)
ref=np.asarray((lambda r: r[0] if isinstance(r,tuple) else r)(model.decode(nets['v0'],xi2,c)))
r=np.linalg.norm(ref,axis=1); print('ref radius pct',np.percentile(r,[1,5,50,95,99]))
for v,a in outs.items():
    rr=np.linalg.norm(a,axis=1)
    d=np.linalg.norm(a[:,None,:]-ref[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)
    ang=np.degrees(np.arctan2(a[:,1],a[:,0]))
    ur=(ang>30)&(ang<75)&(rr>2)
    print(v,'r<1.8',(rr<1.8).mean(),'nn>0.3',(d>0.3).mean(),'UR share by c-bin',[round(ur[(c.numpy()>=b/5)&(c.numpy()<(b+1)/5)].mean(),3) for b in range(5)])

import numpy as np, torch, model
net=model.load(); neg=model.negatives()
uids=list(neg['uid']); mem=[9,73,89,103,115,119]
rows=[uids.index(u) for u in mem]
torch.manual_seed(0)
T=[]
for i in rows:
    c=float(neg['c'][i]); xi=torch.tensor(neg['xi'][i]).float()
    a0=model.decode(net, xi[None], torch.full((1,),c)); a0=np.asarray(a0[0] if isinstance(a0,tuple) else a0)
    # typical samples
    N=512; s=model.decode(net, torch.randn(N,2), torch.full((N,),c)); s=np.asarray(s[0] if isinstance(s,tuple) else s)
    ibs=np.asarray(model.in_basin(i,s))
    # jitter noise
    J=torch.randn(512,2)*0.6; xs=xi[None]+J
    aj=model.decode(net, xs, torch.full((512,),c)); aj=np.asarray(aj[0] if isinstance(aj,tuple) else aj)
    ib=np.asarray(model.in_basin(i,aj))
    # typical: distance to nearest non-basin sample small
    good=s[~ibs]
    d=np.min(np.linalg.norm(aj[:,None]-good[None],axis=2),axis=1)
    ok=(~ib)&(d<0.15)
    dist=J.norm(dim=1).numpy(); dist[~ok]=1e9
    j=int(np.argmin(dist))
    T.append(aj[j])
    print(uids[i], round(c,3), 'a0',a0.round(2),'basin frac',ibs.mean().round(3),'ok frac',ok.mean().round(2),'target',aj[j].round(2),'jit',round(float(dist[j]),2))
np.save('targets.npy', np.array(T,dtype=np.float32))
print(rows)
